## 0.5.4

- Long dictations keep cleanup from successful pieces and report partial fallback accurately. Cleanup waits up to 3.5 seconds plus 1.5 seconds per extra piece, capped at 8 seconds, and stops further requests on a rate limit. Local fallback preserves real sentence ends, mid-sentence splits and terminal/AI prompt text; chat adds no forced final period. A collapsed stutter keeps at least one copy. Guard failures log a reason without text, and unavailable audio recovery warns once per recording.
- A new message no longer starts with a stray space and a lowercase letter after you send the last one. Dicta no longer mistakes the "Ask anything" placeholder in ChatGPT's empty box for text, and in apps that hide their text, such as Orca, pressing Enter, clicking anywhere or moving to another field makes the next dictation start fresh.
- A long recording after a short pause still continues the previous dictation in apps that hide their text; the 60-second timeout now measures the pause before recording starts.
- Undo works more often in Chrome and other Chromium apps: Dicta now waits up to 0.6 s for the paste to show there before giving up on confirming it, instead of 0.2 s.
- The smaller meeting indicator can mute your microphone or call audio in notes and switch the call audio source while recording. Muted spans are marked in the transcript and excluded from summaries and Ask. Pill position in General moves both indicators to Top, Bottom, Left or Right; side positions stack vertically, and Default preserves their original edges.
